q: Near which area is the low pressure region responsible for cyclones in India is normally located?
explanation: Bay of Bengal cyclones that hit India start from low-pressure areas near the Andaman Sea and the Andaman & Nicobar Islands (8–14°N). Mauritius, Maldives and Australia are not their source.

notes.text: - Prepared by **BIS** (**IS 1893**); **four zones – II, III, IV, V** (Zone V = very high damage risk, MSK IX+).

exam: APPSC Group-I Prelims 2003
q: Which of the following coastal regions of India is most prone to cyclones?
explanation:
Most books and keys: Odisha (most landfalls over a century). Andhra Pradesh was hit most in 1995–2020 (NDMI tally, Down To Earth, fetched), and the APPSC GS 2025 key calls AP the most cyclone-prone State (app notes 4:45).
The Orissa (Odisha) coast receives the largest number of Bay of Bengal cyclone landfalls, ahead of the Andhra, Tamil Nadu and west coasts.
